text:
sam: quick heads-up — I'm proposing we ship router v2.3.1 + runtime kernel patch in the 23:00 UTC change window tonight. need api & console pins by EOD.

deploy-bot: release window reserved 2026-03-21T23:00Z -> 2026-03-22T01:00Z. react with :thumbsup: to accept or :x: to block.

jen: tagging in api team — can we pin API to v1.9.4 for the window? we tested compatibility with router v2.3.1 earlier.

ashok: runtime ok for kernel patch, but we want KV-eviction disabled for first 1h after cutover (flag: kv.eviction=false). reduces risk while warmup finishes.

maria: router v2.3.1 includes header-swap fix and graceful-stats draining. should be compatible with api v1.9.4. one caveat: console metrics endpoint path changed, we'll need console pinned to release/feature/router-compat.

sam: sounds good. release notes draft attached in thread — will paste short bullets below. plz review quickly.

release-coordinator: quick checklist: pin versions, update release notes, set deploy-bot canary % to 5% for 15m, enable manual hold at 3m/15m, and set automatic rollback on 5xx rate > 2% for 10m.

jen: confirmed — API -> v1.9.4 pinned. I've cut the branch and added a note in the PR.

ashok: runtime will apply kv.eviction=false via a runtime flag override during rollout. ops note: we need a post-deploy cron to restore eviction after 60 minutes if metrics look stable.

maria: console pinned to release/feature/router-compat. I'll push a patch to the console healthcheck to tolerate the new header order for 30m.

sam: deploy-bot config I want:
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 15m
holdpoints: [3m, 15m]
rollback_on:
  5xx_rate_pct: 2
  latency_p95_increase_pct: 30
```

deploy-bot: config updated in release plan. canary job queued.

jen: release notes bullets (short):
- router v2.3.1: header-swap fix, graceful metric drain
- runtime: kernel patch for attention kernels (perf + stability)
- API v1.9.4: compatibility fixes for header handling
- Console: temporary healthcheck tolerance flag for header order

sam: adding rollback playbook here — keep this short and actionable.

ashok: rollback steps (runtime first):
```
# runtime rollback
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:1.2.9
# router rollback
deploy-bot rollback --service router --to v2.3.0
# api rollback
kubectl -n api set image deploy/api api=api:1.9.3
```

maria: console rollback: redeploy console@main and flip healthcheck to strict. note: dashboard will lose some header-mapped graphs until api is back.

release-coordinator: final gating: everyone ack pins + ops confirm KV flag plan + docs uploaded to release notes. then I'll hit approve to start the pipeline at 22:45 UTC for a 23:00 rollout.

sam: ack from me.

jen: ack (api).

ashok: ack (runtime) — we'll run warmup after canary passes, pushing cache fill jobs to reduce cold-tail latency.

maria: ack (console) — will monitor logs for header-related 4xx spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline scheduled: preflight @ 22:45 UTC, canary start @ 23:00 UTC, canary -> gradual at 23:15 if health gates pass. automated rollback is armed.

sam: if anything looks off at the 3m hold, call rollback. please use the #eng-oncall line for rapid decision.

jen: one more note — include the short troubleshooting tip in the notes: if clients see missing trace headers, toggle header-order-compat on the router (internal flag) and restart the router pods.

ashok: ops action item: I'll add a metric alert to break on p95 latency + user-error spike. alert channel: #eng-sre and paged rotation.

release-coordinator: all required acks present, scheduling preflight. I will update the release doc with exact rollback commands and attach the deploy-bot run id once started.

sam: thanks everyone. will stand by for preflight output. :rocket:

deploy-bot: PREVIEW: canary job created (id: cb-20260321-7169002468). run will post updates in this thread.

maria: will watch metrics during canary. I'll post a short summary at +10m.

jen: will monitor API error budget and auth logs.

ashok: runtime will run the cache warmers at +20m if canary is green.

release-coordinator: last reminder — include release notes link in the client-visible changelog. i've left a placeholder in the doc.

sam: copied. if anyone spots a blocker before 22:30 UTC call it out now.

jen: nothing from api side. good to go.

ashok: good on runtime.

maria: good on console.

release-coordinator: starting preflight in 15m. deploy-bot will post the canary status updates here. good luck all. :thumbsup:
